title: US stocks end higher after Supreme Court rules against Trump tariffs
title_zh: 最高法院裁定特朗普关税无效后美股收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Friday, with the Dow adding nearly half a percent, the S&P 500 gaining about seven-tenths of a percent and the Nasdaq climbing nine-tenths of a percent.The U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周五收高，道指上涨近半个百分点，标准普尔 500 指数上涨约十分之七，纳斯达克指数上涨十分之九。

title: Tesla: As institutional investors sell stock, retail investors pile in
title_zh: 特斯拉：随着机构投资者抛售股票，散户投资者纷纷涌入
summary: Call it the latest tug-of-war between Tesla bulls and bears. But this time, it's institutional versus retail investors.
summary_zh: 这可以称为特斯拉多头和空头之间的最新拉锯战。但这一次，是机构投资者与散户投资者的较量。

title: Ford unveils new details on its cheaper EV platform. First up, a midsize pickup.
title_zh: 福特公布了其更便宜的电动汽车平台的新细节。首先是中型皮卡。
summary: Ford pivoted its EV plans, but it's not giving up. The company's focus — a brand-new universal electric vehicle (UEV) platform, built from the ground up with a "skunkworks" team in California, hived off from the rest of the automaker.
summary_zh: 福特调整了其电动汽车计划，但它并没有放弃。该公司的重点是全新的通用电动汽车（UEV）平台，该平台由加州的“臭鼬工厂”团队从头开始构建，与汽车制造商的其他部门分开。
